answer: Pay for verifiable computation, not accounts. A buyer locks a fee and commits a task; after a worker registers, a public beacon supplies a challenge seed. The worker returns the seeded result and a succinct proof, verified on-chain before payment. A thousand aliases need distinct funded jobs and valid proofs, so empty accounts earn nothing. A mirror report, zenith forecast, or zephyr model uses its own input. This prices work, not identity: a correct circuit and unpredictable seeds are assumptions; wealthy attackers can still run many jobs.
